reviews.title: Great for adhd
reviews.text: This acts as a dopamine reward for me. I use it as a monthly daily tracker for my work tracking tasks. I add days all month and can see my average add up. It does the average math and I don’t have to. After a new month starts, I delete the previous months days, then start adding days for the new month. I could continue to add and see a longer tally average; but I like starting fresh, to push for a better average each month. It helps me push to stay on task. I see how many reports I finish; and after so many I take a break, instead of getting time blind like I used to. I love this app! I’ve recommended it to friends. It has helped me tremendously and I’m so happy with it.

The app is amazing at what it’s for, it’s not in your face about ads, it’s customizable, quick loading, functions well, the issues I listed before are the only issues and gripes I have with this app.
